multi-hop.text: The maximum expire is 1056000 blocks, and 88000 blocks is one month, so that is about 12 months.

tweet.text: Flux Cloud lets you run your own AI model on a network of rented nodes, paid monthly - no cloud contract, no CPU lock-in, no single point of failure. Get a node at fluxcloud.com.

intro.text: Deploying your own AI model on Flux is straightforward: you pack it into a Docker container, describe the resources it needs in a Flux application, and pay per month in FLUX. I'll show you how in this post.
